prompt: A listener on the mobile app reported a wrong badge in the player. Their 10-track playlist is set to repeat, and the editors featured a segment that begins at track 7 and ends before track 3, so it runs over the end of the playlist and back through the top. Track 8 sits inside that segment, but the player shows it without the In Segment badge. The membership check is isTrackInSegment in src/loop-segment.mjs. Run npm test to see the failing regression; it should pass once the bug is fixed.
